assets.scenePrompt: MENTAL HEALTH EXAM PRESSURE EXAMPLE. Pale mint #edf5ec background. Two Black African students, both about 19 years old, in a quiet study corner. View slightly elevated diagonally across a small desk so we see one open planner with blank simple boxes and one pencil. A young woman seated on a stool looks thoughtful and tired, one hand resting near HER planner. Her male friend stands at the adjacent end of desk at a comfortable distance, asking an open question with one relaxed palm rather than pointing or taking control. She chooses one small study task. No triumph, no forced smiles, no suggestion that planning cures distress. Simple open window showing soft green hills. Only relevant study props. Distinct standing/seated arrangement, not a counselling circle. Heads and all hands anatomically clear.
assets.review: Accepted: thoughtful student controls her planner and pencil, friend offers attention without taking over, relevant study props, no implied cure.

assets.scenePrompt: ALCOHOL AND DRUGS AWARENESS EXAMPLE. Solid pale mint #edf5ec background. Wide eye-level composition with one simple empty stool and modest doorway as setting, no other props. NOT two people seated at a table.
